+/**
+ * @brief 向 TH USART1 DMA 环形缓冲注入一帧请求并触发协议轮询
+ */
+static void send_th_req(uint8_t dst, uint8_t flags, uint8_t cmd, const void *pay)
+{
+    uint16_t plen = 0U;
+    if ((cmd == MINIMC_CMD_SET_TEMP) || (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL) ||
+        (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_FILAMENT_CONTROL) || (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_SLOT_SELECT))
+    {
+        plen = 4U;
+    }
+    static uint16_t s_seq = 1U;
+    const uint16_t seq = s_seq++;
+    uint8_t frame[64];
+    frame[0] = MINIMC_SOF_1;
+    frame[1] = MINIMC_SOF_2;
+    frame[2] = MINIMC_NODE_AP;
+    frame[3] = dst;
+    frame[4] = flags;
+    frame[5] = cmd;
+    frame[6] = 3U;
+    frame[7] = MINIMC_ROUTE_IS_ROUTED;
+    frame[8] = (uint8_t)(seq & 0xFFU);
+    frame[9] = (uint8_t)((seq >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    frame[10] = (uint8_t)(plen & 0xFFU);
+    frame[11] = (uint8_t)((plen >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    if ((plen > 0U) && (pay != NULL)) { memcpy(&frame[12], pay, plen); }
+    const uint16_t crc = minimc_crc16(frame, (uint16_t)(12U + plen));
+    frame[12U + plen] = (uint8_t)(crc & 0xFFU);
+    frame[13U + plen] = (uint8_t)((crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    const uint16_t total = (uint16_t)(14U + plen);
+    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < total; ++i)
+    {
+        usart1_rx_buffer[s_usart1_rx_write_pos] = frame[i];
+        s_usart1_rx_write_pos = (uint16_t)((s_usart1_rx_write_pos + 1U) % USART1_RXBUFF_SIZE);
+    }
+    s_usart1_last_tx_len = 0U;
+    minimc_proto_poll();
+}

+/**
+ * @brief 验证 TH Rev 2.0.4 常量、动态 boot_id、0x17 单播/广播急停与 0x19 action>2 边界
+ */
+static void test_th_rev204_bootid_estop_and_filament(void)
+{
+    require_true(MINIMC_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE == 520U && MINIMC_MAX_FRAME_SIZE == 534U, "520B/534B frame size");
+    require_true(MINIMC_CMD_FILAMENT_CONTROL == 0x19U && MINIMC_CMD_SLOT_SELECT == 0x19U, "0x19 FILAMENT_CONTROL");
+    require_true(TH_BOOT_UPGRADE_FLAG_ADDR == 0x20008000UL && TH_BOOT_UPGRADE_MAGIC == 0x55504744UL, "UPGD magic");
+
+    MY_USART1_Init();
+    MY_USART3_Init();
+    thermistor_adcConfig();
+
+    s_mock_tick_ms = 1100U;
+    minimc_proto_init();
+    const uint32_t boot_id_1 = minimc_proto_get_boot_id();
+    s_mock_tick_ms = 2300U;
+    minimc_proto_init();
+    const uint32_t boot_id_2 = minimc_proto_get_boot_id();
+    require_true(boot_id_1 != 0U && boot_id_2 != 0U && boot_id_1 != boot_id_2, "dynamic boot_id changes on init");
+
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_GET_VERSION, NULL);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx_len == 30U && s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_VERSION_REPORT, "0x02 report");
+    uint32_t wire_boot_id = 0U;
+    memcpy(&wire_boot_id, &s_usart1_last_tx[16], 4U);
+    require_true(wire_boot_id == boot_id_2, "0x02 carries dynamic boot_id");
+
+    /* 0x19 action=3 (非法动作) -> NACK 0x03 */
+    const minimc_filament_req_t bad_fil = { 0U, 3U, 100 };
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_SLOT_SELECT, &bad_fil);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_usart1_last_tx[12] == 0x03U, "action=3 -> NACK 0x03");
+
+    /* 0x17 单播 -> 18B (4B payload) 0x00 CMD_ACK；0x17 广播 -> 不回 ACK */
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_EMERGENCY_STOP, NULL);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx_len == 18U && s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK, "unicast 0x17 returns 4B CMD_ACK");
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_BROADCAST, 0x14U, MINIMC_CMD_EMERGENCY_STOP, NULL);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx_len == 0U, "broadcast 0x17 must NOT send ACK");
+}

+/**
+ * @brief 验证 TH 0x1D CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL 安全门禁、0x20008000 UPGD 魔数置位与零 M997 污染
+ */
+static void test_th_sys_ctrl_0x1d_and_zero_m997(void)
+{
+    s_th_magic_word = 0U;
+    s_th_reset_count = 0U;
+    const minimc_sys_ctrl_req_t boot_req = { 2U, 1U, 50U };
+
+    /* 1. 进退料电机忙 (load_filament_Flag != 0) -> NACK 0x05 (DEVICE_BUSY)，零魔数写入 */
+    load_filament_Flag = 1;
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, &boot_req);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_usart1_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY, "busy motor -> NACK 0x05");
+    require_true(s_th_magic_word == 0U && s_th_reset_count == 0U, "no magic when busy");
+    load_filament_Flag = 0;
+
+    /* 2. 加热开启 (thermistor_set_target_deci_c > 0) -> NACK 0x05 */
+    thermistor_set_target_deci_c(2000);
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, &boot_req);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_usart1_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY, "heating active -> NACK 0x05");
+    thermistor_set_target_deci_c(0);
+
+    /* 3. 非法载荷长度 plen=5 -> NACK 0x03；空闲安全态 0x1D (action=2, component=1) -> 18B ACK + 步进失能 + UPGD + 复位 */
+    uint8_t bad_len_frame[19] = {
+        MINIMC_SOF_1, MINIMC_SOF_2, MINIMC_NODE_AP, MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U,
+        MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 3U, MINIMC_ROUTE_IS_ROUTED, 0x77U, 0x00U, 5U, 0U,
+        2U, 1U, 50U, 0U, 0U, 0U, 0U
+    };
+    const uint16_t bad_crc = minimc_crc16(bad_len_frame, 17U);
+    bad_len_frame[17] = (uint8_t)(bad_crc & 0xFFU);
+    bad_len_frame[18] = (uint8_t)((bad_crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < 19U; ++i)
+    {
+        usart1_rx_buffer[s_usart1_rx_write_pos] = bad_len_frame[i];
+        s_usart1_rx_write_pos = (uint16_t)((s_usart1_rx_write_pos + 1U) % USART1_RXBUFF_SIZE);
+    }
+    s_usart1_last_tx_len = 0U;
+    minimc_proto_poll();
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_usart1_last_tx[12] == 0x03U, "0x1D plen=5 -> NACK 0x03");
+
+    s_th_steppers_disabled = false;
+    send_th_req(MINIMC_NODE_TH, 0x05U, MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, &boot_req);
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx_len == 18U && s_usart1_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK, "0x1D returns 4B CMD_ACK");
+    require_true(s_th_steppers_disabled, "0x1D disables all steppers before reset");
+    require_true(s_th_magic_word == TH_BOOT_UPGRADE_MAGIC && s_th_reset_count == 1U && s_th_last_delay_ms == 50U, "UPGD written & reset");
+
+    /* 4. 验证 send_quick 与 USART1_send_string 零 M997 / ok2 串口文本污染 */
+    s_usart1_last_tx_len = 0U;
+    send_quick("ok2\r\nM997 SYSTEM RESET\r\n");
+    USART1_send_string("M997\r\n");
+    require_true(s_usart1_last_tx_len == 0U, "zero M997/ok2 text emitted on USART1");
+}

+static void send_ap_frame(uint8_t dst, uint8_t flags, uint8_t cmd, const void *pay)
+{
+    uint16_t plen = 0U;
+    if ((cmd == MINIMC_CMD_SET_TEMP) || (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL) || (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_FILAMENT_CONTROL)) { plen = 4U; }
+    else if (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START) { plen = 144U; }
+    else if (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_OTA_DATA) { plen = 520U; }
+    else if (cmd == MINIMC_CMD_OTA_FINISH) { plen = 8U; }
+    static uint16_t s_seq = 1U;
+    const uint16_t seq = s_seq++;
+    uint8_t frame[MINIMC_MAX_FRAME_SIZE];
+    frame[0] = MINIMC_SOF_1;
+    frame[1] = MINIMC_SOF_2;
+    frame[2] = MINIMC_NODE_AP;
+    frame[3] = dst;
+    frame[4] = flags;
+    frame[5] = cmd;
+    frame[6] = 4U;
+    frame[7] = 0U;
+    frame[8] = (uint8_t)(seq & 0xFFU);
+    frame[9] = (uint8_t)((seq >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    frame[10] = (uint8_t)(plen & 0xFFU);
+    frame[11] = (uint8_t)((plen >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    if ((plen > 0U) && (pay != NULL)) { memcpy(&frame[12], pay, plen); }
+    const uint16_t crc = minimc_crc16(frame, (uint16_t)(12U + plen));
+    frame[12U + plen] = (uint8_t)(crc & 0xFFU);
+    frame[13U + plen] = (uint8_t)((crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+    s_last_ap_tx_len = 0U;
+    s_last_th_tx_len = 0U;
+    minimc_proto_push_ap_rx(frame, (uint16_t)(14U + plen));
+    minimc_proto_poll();
